newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BOXING-ROMANIAN COACH INVESTIGATED FOR BRIBES.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-ROMANIAN COACH INVESTIGATED FOR BRIBES.

text.p: The Romanian Boxing Federation (RBF) said on Tuesday it had opened an inquiry into allegations that the national coach had extorted money from boxers who won tournaments or were seeking places in the team.
Federation President Valeriu Maltopol told Reuters a commission had been created to investigate charges made by coaches and boxers against Relu Auras.

Former world champion Leonard Doroftei accused Auras of taking some of his prize money after victories in international bouts. "Auras demanded $100 after each match I won," Doroftei told a local television station.
Auras rejected the accusations and said some boxing officials were trying to remove him because of "the tough discipline" he had imposed in the national team.
Under Auras's leadership, Romania gained two bronze medals at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics -- the country's worst Olympic performance.
